:::{#thm-bayes}
#### Bayes' theorem

For any two events $A$ and $B$ with $\Pr(A) > 0$ and $\Pr(B) > 0$
[@wikipedia_bayes_theorem]:

$$\Pr(A \mid B) = \frac{\Pr(B \mid A) \cd \Pr(A)}{\Pr(B)}$$

:::

::: proof

By @def-conditional-prob and @thm-law-conditional-prob:

$$
\ba
\Pr(A \mid B)
&= \frac{\Pr(A \cap B)}{\Pr(B)}
&& \text{(definition of conditional probability)} \\
&= \frac{\Pr(B \cap A)}{\Pr(B)}
&& \text{(intersection is commutative: } A \cap B = B \cap A \text{)} \\
&= \frac{\Pr(B \mid A) \cd \Pr(A)}{\Pr(B)}
&& \text{(law of conditional probability applied to } \Pr(B \cap A) \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
